map.定制参数：画布尺寸取 128-512 随机整数，模块边距取 1-8 随机整数，纠: Custom parameters: canvas size is a random integer 128-512, module margin a random integer 1-8, error-correction level rotates in order through L(7%) / M(15%) / Q(25%) / H(30%), the foreground color is random and the background fixed at #FFFFFF, and the render mode rotates through Canvas / SVG / Image; suggested embedded-logo size = ⌊canvas size × 0.22⌋; container CSS padding = margin × 4 px
map.输入网址或文本，按 ISO/IEC 18004 生成标准二维码，可调尺寸、纠错等: Turn a URL or text into a standard ISO/IEC 18004 QR code with adjustable size, error-correction level, quiet zone and colours; download as PNG or SVG.
map.按 UTF-8 字节长度选择版本（1–40，模块数 = 4 × 版本 + 17）: The version (1–40; module count = 4 × version + 17) is chosen from the UTF-8 byte length: input → Byte-mode encoding → Reed-Solomon error-correction codewords for level L/M/Q/H → best mask → matrix. Canvas pixels are yours to set; module size = canvas size ÷ (modules + 2 × quiet zone), quiet zone defaults to 4 modules (ISO/IEC 18004 asks for at least 4). Byte-mode capacity at version 40 is L 2953 / M 2331 / Q 1663 / H 1273 bytes, and anything longer is refused instead of truncated.
map.用项目内置的 qrcode.js（Kazuhiko Arase，MIT）做真实: Real QR encoding with the bundled qrcode.js (Kazuhiko Arase, MIT): version and mask are picked automatically, Reed-Solomon codewords are computed, and the standard matrix is rendered to SVG at your size, quiet zone and colours. Download PNG or SVG; everything runs locally and your text is never uploaded.
map.把网址或文本按 UTF-8 编码成标准二维码：自动选择版本（1–40）与最优掩码: Encode a URL or text into a standard QR code: the version (1–40) and best mask are chosen automatically, Reed-Solomon codewords are added for your error-correction level, and the result is rendered to SVG at your canvas size, quiet zone and colours, downloadable as PNG or SVG. Paste several lines to get one code per line; content beyond the capacity limit is reported explicitly instead of being silently truncated. Everything runs locally and your text is never uploaded.
map.真实 QR 编码（ISO/IEC 18004），按内容自动选版本与掩码: Real QR encoding (ISO/IEC 18004) with automatic version and mask selection

map.纠错等级越高越抗污损但模块越密，普通屏幕与印刷场景 M/L 即可: Higher error correction resists damage better but packs modules tighter; M or L is enough for screens and ordinary print
map.二维码四周须保留静区（默认 4 模块），静区被裁切会导致无法识读: Keep the quiet zone (4 modules by default) around the code; cropping it makes the code unreadable
map.深色前景 + 浅色背景对比度不足时扫码器可能读不出，建议保持明暗反差: Low contrast between a dark foreground and a light background can defeat scanners; keep a clear light/dark contrast
map.越高越抗污损，但同样内容会占用更多码字、可能抬高版本（模块更小更密）。屏幕展示与: Higher levels resist damage better but consume more codewords, which can push the version up and make modules smaller and denser. M is fine for screens and ordinary print; use Q or H for surfaces that wear (cup labels, equipment tags).
map.下载的 PNG / SVG 能直接用吗？: Can I use the downloaded PNG / SVG directly?
map.可以直接使用：SVG 为矢量、可无损放大，适合印刷与排版；PNG 为按设定尺寸导: Yes. SVG is vector and scales losslessly, which suits print and layout work; PNG is a bitmap exported at the size you set. Keep the quiet zone, avoid heavy re-compression, and scan with a phone before printing in bulk.
